notes.title: Dev diary: What's coming up for Lord Goblin?
notes.content: [p]Hello Steam community! This is the first time I've written a dev diary here, but it's just because we've been so busy. We're a tiny team on a tiny budget, but we're dedicated and working on the game all the time.[/p][p]In the future I'll try to post here occasionally, perhaps putting up some of the dev diaries I wrote in the past, as well as giving you some info on where the game is going.[/p][p][/p][h3][b][u]Update times[/u][/b][/h3][p]First, a bit of business, before the fun announcements. We don't want to commit just yet to a specific date for the next update, but the longer it takes the more new content will be in it, so don't feel too bad about the delay. We just need time to cook.[/p][p]I'll try to be as transparent as I can; due to Steam's terms of service I can't really talk about crowd funding or anything like that, but just rest assured that we [i]are[/i] putting together new builds with new content every month like clockwork, so the game development is progressing in the background even when you don't hear about it. (Though you can certainly get way more news on our Discord server!)[/p][p]If it were entirely up to me to do it then we'd do even less frequent Steam updates because I like it when a patch can be really huge and contain loads of stuff, and more frequent updates doesn't mean more content, it just means the content is more spread out. Oh, and managing Steam updates does take time and effort for us too, of course. But we know that it gets frustrating for Steam players to wait [i]too[/i] long so we need to make sure we put out new updates here from time to time. Some players are very anxious for more![/p][p][/p][h3][b][u]Coming soon[/u][/b][/h3][p]A big new feature we've already implemented is a new character: Queen Fina![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055310/780cbcfdb02a532248d4d29baf40668fb502b13b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The legendarily beautiful Queen of the realm will soon be gracing Greenwood with her august and curvaceous presence. You'll need to make sure that your castle's hospitality is fit for a royal visit! (Or at least have enough wine in the cellar to get her interested.)[/p][p]As for upcoming [b]romance[/b], Beth is in the spotlight in the new scenes recently implemented. It's time to discover more about her personality, her past, her beliefs and her... desires.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055310/fba2feb547be47fdbddbc3ddee54060383370b9c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]There's a new [b]Delia BJ animation[/b] that we've implemented, so that's something to definitely look forward to.[/p][p]And we've been making a lot of [b]gameplay improvements[/b] to balance and adjusting features, to make the whole experience more fun and satisfying. (That's an ongoing project, obviously!)[/p][p][/p][h3][b][u]Future plans[/u][/b][/h3][p]I know some people have been wondering what the long term plans for the game's structure are, so just in brief, yes, there will be full romance arcs for each of the ladies, and there will also be a complete story mode. Once the story is over, you'll be able to continue to play in post-game, to unlock anything else. We also intend to add some high level stuff to grind for if you want to hang about in the end game mode (new text and voicing for existing scenes, new outfits, etc.).[/p][p][b]The wardrobe[/b] is actively in development, which will allow you to equip the special outfits you can buy at the shop. This is a bigger feature to implement than you might think, because we need to finish all the animated character sprites (the most complex animations in the game!) and implement them throughout the game. We're close to being able to enable Beth's wardrobe options at least, and then we'll phase in other characters as we complete them.[/p][p][b]Bathing[/b] with a lady (or more than one!) will probably be possible fairly soon, as we have the animation mostly finished. This will be a fun way to pass the time by selecting one of the women to join you in the bath and get the lord good and clean.[/p][p][b]New sexy animations[/b] are on the way too - we've got multiple complete for several different ladies, and we just need to get them all set up.[/p][p][/p][p]If you want to chat about what's coming, [b]check out our [url="https://discord.gg/nn9G3ZB"]Discord server[/url]![/b][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update notes for Hotfix v0.34.3
notes.content:
[h1]Version 0.34.3 change log:[/h1]

Just a small fix to address a soft lock problem.

[b]- Bug fixes / Miscellaneous:[/b]

Fixed an issue with the Morning event on Day 09 Month 03 not triggering properly, resulting in a soft lock.


[h3]Looking for your old save files?[/h3]
There was a problem with the old save file location, but if you're looking for your old saves you can still find them.

Your old save data will be stored at:
C:\Users\User\AppData\LocalLow\DefaultCompany\Lord Goblin

You want to copy/past the files in there into:
C:\Users\User\AppData\LocalLow\BigBrassBand\Lord Goblin

That said, old saves often introduce bugs. Regardless, we shouldn't have to do this again in the future.

notes.title: The Heroes & Villeins Update - v0.34.2
notes.content:
No, the event name is not a misspelling- it's villein as in serf. It's a feudalism pun. We're bringing you more of what you want- more animations, more sex scenes, more voice acting, and new court events! We hope you guys enjoy what we've been cooking up!

Additionally, we are working on adding in support for more aspect ratios/resolution, do not hesitate to share your feedback on this matter.

Overview-
[list]
[*] A new animated sex scene in the introduction,
[*] A new animated Cliona blowjob ritual,
[*] A new event chain that can lead to a Delia spanking reward scene,
[*] Revisions to the "Vital Villeins" and "Aspiring Artisans" events, so that they will now occur every week once you've upgraded the crops or bridge respectively, and will allow you to reliably buy more population,
[*] Many new voiced lines throughout the game,
[*] Other new holding court events,
[*] UI improvements,
[*] Many bug fixes.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055310/146d569c6ad79685644133f7f0f809dda55352fc.gif[/img]

See the full changelog below for more info

[b]Version 0.34.2 changelog:[/b]

[b]- Gameplay & UI related changes:[/b]

[b]- 'Holding Court' screen:[/b]
'Delia the Disgrace (part 2)' Random event added as part of an event chain (2 of 2)
'Delia the Disgrace spanking scene' added as possible choice of 'Delia the Disgrace (part 2)'
Reworked the 'Aspiring artisans' into a weekly event (Friday), unlocked after upgrading the 'Bridge' in the Village
Reworked the 'Vital villeins' into a weekly event (Thursday), unlocked after upgrading the 'Crops' in the Village

[b]- 'Manor' screen[/b]
Updated the intro sex scene with some animation
Added a new scene involving Az'ea and Cliona arguing about civilisation while in town (from 6th day, 4th month), as a prerequisite and lead up to the existing similar scene of them arguing about Lord Goblin needing a harem
Added some voicelines for current content

[b]- 'Perform Ritual' screen[/b]
Updated Cliona's blowjob ritual sprites with a proper arm free variant

[b]- 'Holding Court' screen[/b]
'Why, fallow there!' Random event added
'Sir Tainly, Sir' Random one time event added as part of an event chain (1 of 2)
'Sir Tainly Important' Random one time event added as possible follow-up to 'Sir Tainly, Sir' (2 of 2)
'Sir Tainly Angry' Random one time event added as possible follow-up to 'Sir Tainly, Sir' (2 of 2)

[b]- Bug fixes / Miscellaneous:[/b]

Fixed the Barracks 'Upgrade' button not behaving properly
Fixed the 'Perform Ritual' button not bringing in the 'Portal Ritual' UI properly
Fixed the ambiance sound persisting when going back to the Main Menu
Fixed the 'Clean up a room' job action not resetting properly
Fixed the 'A cock laid an egg' event first choice being greyed out if legitimacy was at or below 4
Fixed the 'Word On The Street 02' event first choice leading to the same outcome as the second
Fixed the condition check for Cliona's ('Ritual Blowjob') to 25 obedience
Fixed Beth's 'Ritual Titjob (Interested)' not properly displaying the choices and causing a soft lock
Fixed the 'Aspiring artisans' condition check
Fixed the 'Vital villeins' condition check

notes.title: Lord Goblin is Now Available in Early Access!
notes.content:
It's been a long and rocky road to get to this point! After the troubles we've experienced with a certain platform that has "P" in it's name, we were blown away by the amount of support we received from you guys to support us on other platforms, as well as the support we've received from other adult devs.

Today is a big day for us, as we're finally at a point where we feel ready for Steam. This isn't our first game, we've also completed [b][i]Pervert Action: Legacy[/i][/b] and [i][b]Pervert Action: Timelapse[/b][/i], however this IS our first game that is available on Steam. Thus a Steam release is new and exciting for us, but we're happy to be working with our publisher, TinyHat Studios, who will be helping us with the Steam side of things.

Otherwise, we hope you guys enjoy this initial Early Access launch of Lord Goblin! As a reminder, future updates will be free, so if you lock in now, you'll be getting a ton of new content, regularly, as it's ready!
We'll be keeping an eye on the forums and Discord to get feedback from you guys, but also feel free to leave a review to let us, and others, know what you think about the game!
